answer: A staked reputation trellis links each agent ID to bonded collateral and a concave reward curve. Rewards scale sublinearly with stake, so splitting one balance across fake IDs leaves total payout unchanged or lower after per-ID fees; at the tide of high demand, colluding IDs still face shared capital and audit risk. Attacker costs include slashed bonds and verification fees; limitations: wealthy attackers can absorb costs, and the nadir of low activity reduces audit signal.
